conflicts.detail: The current Global Immersion page names San Francisco, Tokyo, Buenos Aires and A European City (Berlin and London as past cities). The 2024-04-23 release lists San Francisco, Berlin, Buenos Aires, Hyderabad, Seoul, Taipei and Tokyo. The Experience Global Immersion page lists recent and current cities as San Francisco, Berlin, Buenos Aires, Hyderabad, London, Seoul and Taipei (no Tokyo) and refers to Fall 2025 applications, so it is older.
Not on the current Global Immersion page. The 2026-02-04 release relaunches it as an undergraduate rotation city (T-Hub partner) without saying which year or stop it fills.

The Undergraduate page groups Years 3 & 4 as Focus & Synthesis (Buenos Aires & a European Experience) without saying which city is which year; the Global Immersion page orders Buenos Aires as Stop 3 and a European city as Stop 4. Year assignment here follows the Stop order.
